failure.known_boundary: Native model adapter before regular answer validation; no validation_codes on final failure diagnostic. Exact protocol/subprocess/evidence substage unavailable.
failure.root_cause: unresolved: no raw protocol envelope or subprocess stderr retained; exact invalidity cannot be reconstructed
failure.no_claim: Not evidence of search failure, invalid simulation result or unauthorized data access; no speculative attribution to provider outage/limits.

stopping_rule: Final fixed validation failed. No rerun, extra generation, candidate general, merge/push or promotion. Prior failure evidence preserved. G12 unclosed and G8/G9/G10/food remain separate.

usage.counter_scope: Gateway operations plus native completed events; historical130 includes root inspections and retained overage. Reused baseline excluded. Active/uncaptured generations must be accounted separately; candidate/live general to be added after execution.

tool_reuse: Existing native search and equipment/compare tools successfully completed six experiments. New failure needs bounded error classification in existing stdio adapter, not a replacement search/tool subsystem.
release_helper_note: Local-only drafted recovery-model cap has two mocked branch tests. Not uploaded, pinned or executed; no claim of accepted release readiness for modified helper.
